moments.title: F1 Dutch Grand Prix Race Day
moments.blurb: Today is race day for the Formula 1 Heineken Dutch Grand Prix at Circuit Zandvoort, with Lando Norris starting on pole position after a thrilling qualifying session.

angles.name: Race Day Excitement
angles.copy: Lights out and away we go! It's race day at Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix. Can Lando Norris convert pole into a win? Tune in!

angles.name: Norris on Pole
angles.copy: Lando Norris on pole for the Dutch GP today! After yesterday's electric qualifying, can he hold off the competition and take the top step?

moments.title: US Open Fan Week Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The US Open Fan Week begins today, offering free access to the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center ahead of the main tournament starting August 30.

angles.name: Tennis Fever
angles.copy: Game, set, match! US Open Fan Week kicks off today in New York, with the main draw starting next Sunday. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Road to the Final
angles.copy: The final Grand Slam of the year is almost here! US Open Fan Week starts today, building excitement for the tennis action in Flushing Meadows.

moments.title: All Points East: Deftones Headline
moments.blurb: All Points East festival continues today in London's Victoria Park, with rock legends Deftones headlining the Sunday night bill.

angles.name: Rocking Victoria Park
angles.copy: Deftones are bringing the heavy to Victoria Park tonight as All Points East continues! Who's there for the riffs?

angles.name: Sunday Headliner
angles.copy: Sunday night at All Points East means Deftones are taking the stage! London is rocking this Bank Holiday weekend.

moments.title: Julian Casablancas turns 48
moments.blurb: Julian Casablancas, frontman of The Strokes and The Voidz, celebrates his 48th birthday today.

angles.name: Strokes Icon
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to Julian Casablancas! The distinctive voice of The Strokes and The Voidz. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Indie Legend
angles.copy: From 'Is This It' to 'The New Abnormal', Julian Casablancas turns 48 today! A true indie rock legend.

moments.title: Rick Springfield turns 77
moments.blurb: Australian-American singer, songwriter, and actor Rick Springfield, known for 'Jessie's Girl,' celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Jessie's Girl Hero
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Rick Springfield! Still wishing I was 'Jessie's Girl' (or boy!).

angles.name: Pop-Rock Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Rick Springfield's 77th birthday today! A pop-rock icon with a timeless sound.

moments.title: Lil Yachty turns 29
moments.blurb: American rapper and songwriter Lil Yachty, known for hits like 'One Night' and 'Broccoli,' celebrates his 29th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday Boat
angles.copy: Happy 29th Birthday to the one and only Lil Yachty! What's your favourite track from the 'Boat'?

angles.name: Genre-Bending Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Lil Yachty's 29th birthday today! Always pushing boundaries in hip-hop and beyond.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart No. 1: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the UK Official Singles Chart for another week with their hit 'Rein Me In'.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are reigning over the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: Weekend Listen
angles.copy: If you're wondering what to listen to this Sunday, the UK's No.1 is still 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean. A true anthem!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, kicks off on Thursday, August 27th, in Daresbury, Cheshire, running until August 30th.

angles.name: Dance Weekend Incoming
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Creamfields kicks off on Thursday for a massive Bank Holiday weekend of electronic dance music in Cheshire. Get ready to rave!

angles.name: Who's Heading to Creamfields?
angles.copy: Creamfields is just days away! With headliners like Swedish House Mafia and Calvin Harris, it's set to be an epic one. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Start
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals begin on Thursday, August 27th, bringing a huge lineup including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C. to two sites across the UK.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! Starting Thursday, it's going to be a massive Bank Holiday weekend of music. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Double Trouble
angles.copy: Two festivals, one huge weekend! Reading & Leeds kicks off this Thursday with a stellar lineup across rock, pop, and hip-hop.

moments.title: Elvis Costello turns 72
moments.blurb: Influential English singer-songwriter Elvis Costello celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 25th.

angles.name: Punk Poet
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the legendary Elvis Costello! From 'Pump It Up' to 'Alison', what's your favourite track from the punk poet?

angles.name: Musical Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 72nd Birthday to the incomparable Elvis Costello on August 25th! A true musical icon.

moments.title: Rob Halford turns 75
moments.blurb: Rob Halford, the iconic frontman of heavy metal band Judas Priest, celebrates his 75th birthday on August 25th.

angles.name: Metal God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the Metal God himself, Rob Halford of Judas Priest! Still screaming for vengeance.

angles.name: Heavy Metal Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating 75 years of pure heavy metal power! Happy Birthday to Judas Priest's legendary frontman, Rob Halford, on August 25th.

moments.title: Gene Simmons turns 77
moments.blurb: Gene Simmons, the legendary bassist and co-lead singer of Kiss, celebrates his 77th birthday on August 25th.

angles.name: Kiss Legend
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Happy 77th Birthday to the Demon himself, Gene Simmons of Kiss, on August 25th!

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! Gene Simmons, the iconic bassist from Kiss, turns 77 this Tuesday. What's your favourite Kiss anthem?

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 59
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the fierce Scottish lead singer of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 59th birthday on August 26th.

angles.name: Garbage Queen
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage! A true icon of 90s alternative rock.

angles.name: Scottish Rocker
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Scotland's own Shirley Manson on August 26th! What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Valerie Simpson turns 81
moments.blurb: Valerie Simpson, half of the legendary R&B songwriting and performing duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 81st birthday on August 26th.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson! A true force in soul music as half of Ashford & Simpson.

angles.name: R&B Royalty
angles.copy: Celebrating Valerie Simpson's 81st birthday on August 26th! Her contributions to R&B and soul are legendary.

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Canadian country-pop superstar Shania Twain celebrates her 61st birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Let's Go Girls!
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! Feeling like a woman in charge today!

angles.name: Country-Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the incredible Shania Twain on August 28th! What's your favourite hit from the country-pop queen?

moments.title: Jack Black turns 57
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and musician Jack Black, known for Tenacious D and various film roles, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the legend that is Jack Black! From Tenacious D to Hollywood, he truly is the 'School of Rock'!

angles.name: Multi-Talent Star
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredibly talented Jack Black's 57th birthday on August 28th! What's your favourite Jack Black moment?

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, lead singer of the acclaimed band Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the enchanting Florence Welch! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', her voice is truly magical.

angles.name: Musical Force
angles.copy: Celebrating the fabulous Florence Welch's 40th birthday this Wednesday! A decade-defining voice in British music.

moments.title: Debbie Gibson turns 56
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and actress Debbie Gibson, a pop icon of the late 80s, celebrates her 56th birthday on August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the original pop princess, Debbie Gibson, on August 31st! Still 'Lost In Your Eyes' over her hits!

angles.name: Electric Youth
angles.copy: Celebrating Debbie Gibson's 56th birthday this Monday! Who remembers 'Electric Youth'?
